verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an enterprise group-management doc saying users can search across all projects in a single portal, which shows ReadMe has reader-facing search. It gives no detail on speed, typo tolerance, relevance ranking, or whether search is on by default on standard plans. Ask AI returns AI answers rather than site search, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented typo tolerance, relevance ranking, performance/speed claims, confirmation of out-of-the-box full-site search on non-enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, readers get fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search over the whole docs site out of the box

citations.quote: Configure a single docs portal where users can view and search all of your projects
